title: UFC channel
changes: New channel 420: full UFC fights from the UFC's own YouTube channel (Family profile)

title: Keeps playing when a video fails
changes: If a show won't play, the TV tries it again, then shows a stand-in until the next show, so the schedule stays the same
The guide and banner say when something is a stand-in

title: Report a problem
changes: MENU, Settings: tell us about a problem and it goes straight to the app's owner

title: Shows from another computer
changes: A Retro TV computer can share its drives over the internet; when it does, its shows appear here for everyone
Shared computers can skip the passcode

title: Sports and wrestling in order
changes: NBA Finals plays each series back to back, Game 1 onward
Wrestling events play in the order they happened; Indy Wrestling plays each event match by match
New ORDER button: switch a sports or wrestling channel between history order and random

title: Watch your PC's shows
changes: If your PC runs the home server, open its address in Safari and enter the passcode: its shows join their channels
Settings has a new Shows on your PC section

title: NBA Finals, sports for Family, fixes
changes: New channel 410: NBA Finals, 99 full Finals games from 1987 on, no repeats
Wrestling and sports (400-499) now show in the Family profile
During YouTube ads a small remote stays on screen, so you can always change the channel
Turning the phone sideways and back keeps the picture the right size

title: Indy Wrestling and smoother YouTube ads
changes: Channel 404 is now Indy Wrestling, starting with every Limitless Wrestling event (Late Night)
When YouTube plays an ad, the whole picture shows so you can tap Skip, then the show goes back to full screen

title: Sharper picture, English only, scrolling guide

YouTube channels are English only

The guide scrolls with your finger; tap a channel to watch it
Live YouTube channels respond to swipes once they start
Updates now install by themselves, and this What's New screen shows what changed
